name: helve
description: One API key and MCP server for 313+ pay-per-call and free tools: web search, extraction, LLMs, SEC filings, arXiv, audio, and developer data.

interface.shortDescription: 313+ agent tools, one metered balance, per-key spend caps, no monthly fees.
interface.longDescription: Helve is a metered all-tools gateway for high-frequency AI agent workloads (deep research, crawl/extract batches, audio transcription/TTS, and multi-model LLM routing) across 313 tools and 255 providers. Agents discover tools dynamically via semantic search, pay per call from one prepaid balance ($10/$25/$100 packs—no monthly subscription gate; $0.50 free credit on signup), enforce deterministic per-key spend_limit_usd caps (returning 402 spend_limit_exceeded before runaway bills happen), and pay $0 for failed upstream calls.
defaultPrompt: Search Helve for the best web crawl and deep research tools for a batch job, check their per-call prices, and run a multi-source research summary.
Find audio transcription and SEC filing tools on Helve, estimate the cost, and run the workflow.
Check my Helve account balance and API key spend_limit_usd cap, then find low-cost SEC filing and company data tools.
